summary.name: JetBrains Student Pack
summary.one_liner: A free JetBrains program giving eligible students access to JetBrains IDEs, AI tools, and coding courses for the duration of their studies.
use_cases: Getting free professional IDEs for university coursework
Using PyCharm or IntelliJ IDEA for class assignments and thesis work
Learning to code with JetBrains Academy courses
Accessing free DataGrip for SQL and database projects
Getting a discount on JetBrains tools after graduation
summary.what_it_does: The page describes two student options: a single-IDE free license needing no student verification, and the full Student Pack with access to 10 JetBrains IDEs, JetBrains Academy coding courses, and a JetBrains AI Pro trial, which requires verification. Verification uses a university email address, an ISIC/ITIC card, or the GitHub Student Developer Pack. Access lasts for the duration of studies and is renewed annually through a JetBrains Account. The page also says that after graduation students get 40% off JetBrains products for two years. Free non-commercial licenses are mentioned for other IDEs such as RustRover, Rider, WebStorm, CLion, RubyMine, and DataGrip.
notable: Free access to 10 JetBrains IDEs for full-time students in programs lasting one year or more
JetBrains AI trial included, with code completion, AI chat, and an AI coding agent
40% discount for two years after graduation
caveats: Licenses are strictly for non-commercial educational purposes; commercial work needs a paid subscription or employer license
Only for students in accredited programs lasting longer than one year; shorter programs are referred to the Teacher Pack
The AI tools are a limited trial
